wikidot5e:spell:hunters-mark.effectSummary: Mark one visible creature within 90 feet as your quarry. Until the spell ends, each weapon hit against it deals an extra 1d6 damage, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find it. If it reaches 0 HP, you can use a bonus action on a later turn to mark a new creature. A 3rd- or 4th-level slot extends concentration to up to 8 hours; a 5th-level-or-higher slot extends it to up to 24 hours.

wikidot5e:spell:hypnotic-pattern.effectSummary: Create a momentary pattern in a 30-foot cube within 120 feet. Each creature there that can see it makes a Wisdom save; on a failure it is charmed, incapacitated, and has speed 0 for up to 1 minute. The effect ends early for a creature if it takes any damage or another creature uses an action to shake it out of the stupor.

wikidot5e:spell:ice-knife.effectSummary: Make a ranged spell attack with a shard of ice against one creature within 60 feet. On a hit the target takes 1d10 piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard explodes; the target and every creature within 5 feet of the explosion make Dexterity saves or take 2d6 cold damage. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 to the cold damage.

wikidot5e:spell:ice-storm.effectSummary: Hail pounds a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered within 300 feet. Creatures there make Dexterity saves, taking 2d8 bludgeoning plus 4d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. Each slot level above 4th adds 1d8 bludgeoning damage.

wikidot5e:spell:identify.effectSummary: Touch one object throughout the 1-minute casting to learn its magical properties and use, whether it requires attunement, its charges, any spells affecting it, and which spell created it if applicable. If you instead touch a creature throughout the casting, learn what spells are currently affecting that creature.

wikidot5e:spell:illusory-dragon.effectSummary: Create a Huge tangible shadow-dragon illusion in a visible unoccupied space within 120 feet for up to 1 minute. Enemies that see it when it appears make Wisdom saves or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of a turn when they lack line of sight to the dragon. As a bonus action, move it up to 60 feet and, during that movement, breathe a 60-foot cone of one chosen damage type—acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or poison—forcing Intelligence saves for 7d6 damage, half on success. Attacks automatically miss the dragon; it succeeds on all saves and is immune to damage and conditions. A creature can use an action for an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to recognize the illusion; on success it can see through it and has advantage on saves against its breath.

wikidot5e:spell:illusory-script.effectSummary: Write a message on suitable material that lasts 10 days. You and creatures chosen at casting see the real text; everyone else sees either unintelligible magical writing or a different message of your choice written in another hand and a language you know. If dispelled, both the original script and illusion disappear. Truesight reveals the hidden message.

wikidot5e:spell:immolation.effectSummary: One visible creature within 90 feet makes a Dexterity save. It takes 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. On a failed save it also burns for up to 1 minute, shedding bright light for 30 feet and dim light for another 30; at the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failure and ending the spell on a success. Nonmagical means cannot extinguish these flames. A target killed by this spell becomes ash.

wikidot5e:spell:icingdeath-s-frost.effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot cone make Constitution saves. On a failure, a creature takes 3d8 cold damage and is encased in ice for up to 1 minute, reducing its speed to 0 until it or another creature uses an action to break the ice away. On a success it takes half damage with no speed effect. Each slot level above 2nd adds 1d8 cold damage.

wikidot5e:spell:id-insinuation.effectSummary: One visible creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or becomes incapacitated for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns it takes 1d12 psychic damage, then repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on itself on a success.
